what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as owner. Home showed a chat screen with Inbox badge 9. Opened Inbox, which landed on Change requests with 'Needs you 8' and 'Updates 10'. Scrolled the list: 8 Draft change requests (#15, #14, #13, #12, #11, #8, #7, #6), each with a Review change button. #15 'Has any conversation or activity record been changed after the event?'; #14 'Add a new expense account Site safety equipment under direct expenses'; #13, #12, #11, #8, #7, #6 all described only as 'Submitted from a form.' Approvals tab showed nothing waiting (All caught up). So 8 requests await my decision, though sidebar/tab badges say 9.
unnecessary_steps: Had to scroll through a long list of tall cards to see all 8; no compact summary
confusing_terminology: Change requests vs Approvals vs 'Needs you' vs 'Updates' -> unclear which counts as 'waiting for my decision'
'Draft' status on items awaiting my approval -> sounds like unsent, not pending
'Submitted from a form.' -> says nothing about what the change is
missing_feedback: No way to see what 'Submitted from a form' requests are without opening each one
unexpected_behaviour: Badge on Inbox and Change requests says 9 but 'Needs you' shows 8 and 8 are listed
Signed in as owner but sidebar shows 'StudioOS Administrator, admin' and greeting 'Good morning, StudioOS'
visual_issues: Cards are very tall with lots of whitespace so only about 2 per screen
Small low-contrast grey text for descriptions/dates
Header 'Needs you 8' count in pill is small
accessibility_issues: Small grey text; badge counts rely on color/size; did not test keyboard
observations: Inbox with a badge was easy to find and the answer was reachable in about 3 actions, but the number mismatch (9 vs 8) and uninformative descriptions make it hard to trust the count or know what each request is without opening it.

rating_justifications.clarity_of_terminology: Six of eight requests read only 'Submitted from a form.' with status 'Draft'; badge 9 vs 'Needs you 8'; 'Change requests' vs 'Approvals' overlap.
